title: HEE Object Envelope Schema
description: Envelope schema for all HEE objects. Designed to support kubectl-style label selectors. Guardrail: every HEE object MUST set metadata.labels.hee.object = "true" to prevent collisions with non-HEE Kubernetes objects.

apiVersion.description: API version of the HEE object

kind.description: Kind of the HEE object (e.g., Contract, Pill, Plan)

description.description: Human-readable description of the HEE object

labels.description: Labels for kubectl-selector semantics. HEE objects MUST include hee.object=true. Contract objects MUST include hee.contract.type and hee.contract.phase.

hee.object.description: Sentinel label marking this as a HEE object. Prevents selector collisions with non-HEE Kubernetes objects.

hee.contract.type.description: Contract type discriminator used for selectors (e.g., dir-layout). Required when kind=Contract.

hee.contract.phase.description: Contract phase used for selectors. Required when kind=Contract.

annotations.description: Annotations for the HEE object (k8s-qualified key syntax: optional prefix/name). inuid is special-cased below: it is the one annotation permitted to be null, and only when paired with inuid_null_reason. See hee/contracts/hee.kind-registry.contract.v1.yaml for the governing invariant.

inuid.description: Deterministic identity (sha256 of a documented seed string) for this HEE object. May be null only for a genuine bootstrap/test/fixture case -- see inuid_null_reason, required whenever inuid is null (enforced below, applies in base mode too, not strict-only).

inuid_null_reason.description: Required if and only if inuid is null. No other reason is valid.

allOf.description: If annotations.inuid is present and null, inuid_null_reason must also be present. Applies whenever inuid appears at all (base mode included) -- inuid presence itself is not required here, only well-formedness when present. Strict mode (hee-object.strict.schema.json) additionally requires inuid to be present.
